observations: Backend vs OpenAPI: GuidedSessionController.result answers 202 with the SESSION VIEW body (no outcome) for a non-terminal session, while openapi documents the 202 body as a result with publication PENDING. The client calls readResult only after a terminal state, so it never meets the session-view body. The mirror follows the document (a 202 result with publication PENDING and outcome = current state). Worth an architect look, not changed here.

Backend: a pending publication also answers 202 on a TERMINAL session (publication.status PENDING -> 202). The hook therefore sets pending=PUBLICATION_PENDING and re-reads the result up to 60 times before giving up.

ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED, MISSING_SOURCE and BUDGET_EXCEEDED also occur as a session's errorCode (GuidedSessionService), not only as start refusals. The mirror offers them as terminal FAILED results (endsIn with failureCode) and the other start refusals as 409/429 responses.
mockChoicesNotInContract: capability guidedStart.context: environmentId = the draft's environment label, applicationId = its CSI; a draft with no steps is RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE (D-11); a CSI in MOCK_EXECUTE_DENIED_CSIS is FORBIDDEN_SCOPE

A cancel of a running session ends CANCELLED with publication REFUSED; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME defaults to REFUSED unless a test asks for PENDING; revision mismatch on start/finalize answers REVISION_CONFLICT with messageCode = code; a clarify with a stale generation answers STALE_GENERATION 409 and an unoffered choice 400 INVALID_CONTRACT

Step IDs come from fixtureStepId(i) in authoringState.ts (read-only import). A test created through the authoring mock keeps its own step IDs there, so root F1 should pass stepsOf to createGuidedHandlers if guided progress must match those IDs
autoDecisions: [AUTO-DECISION] Hook uses Redux for view/result/clarification (the four slice keys) and local state for pending and startRefusal. Mount it once per page; components take its return value as props.
[AUTO-DECISION] startLearn rejects only when no response ever arrived (pointer kept); every HTTP outcome resolves and is visible in startRefusal or pending. Callers should catch the rejection.
[AUTO-DECISION] 401 stops polling (pointer kept, resume on reload); the login redirect reloads the app anyway. 403 forgets everything. No-response reads are retried silently by the next tick.
[AUTO-DECISION] Session reads keep apiClient's default GET retry (2 retries, 200 ms then 400 ms), so a 503 shows as NOT_READY about 600 ms after it starts. Only getCapabilities opts out.

[AUTO-DECISION] Clarify and cancel keys are memoized in memory per logical operation (session + clarification + generation + choice; session). A reload starts a new operation, which the server treats as a no-op on a session that has moved on; only start and finalize keys are persisted, as P6 specifies.
[AUTO-DECISION] Result re-read while the recording is PROCESSING is bounded at 60 reads (about a minute at the default interval) so a recording that never settles does not poll forever.
[AUTO-DECISION] Mock scenarios advance by read count, not time; gates hold at AWAITING_CLARIFICATION and FINALIZING.
